fusions.name: Choked to the Ferrule
fusions.desc: You slide your grip to the very end of the staff for a thrust at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Knuckle Rap
fusions.desc: A short-gripped rap at an enemy within 2 tiles that deals 5 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Grip
fusions.desc: You settle your grip on the staff, raising your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused: you catch yourself on the staff and are left at 1 health.
